title: The Estuary's Infinite Ledger

features.name: the-water-s-accounting
features.desc-on-touch: Ledgers written in flow itself, each line a current, each sum dissolving into the next. The water counts in a mathematics that is true one moment and false the next.

features.name: the-tidal-balance
features.desc-on-touch: A perfect scale holding the river's flow on one side, the ocean's pull on the other. They are always unequal, always balanced. The contradiction is the equation.

features.name: the-current-s-memory
features.desc-on-touch: Water that flows backwards only in remembering. It carries the files of everything it has already counted toward the sea, and then forgets them.

features.name: the-ledger-tower
features.desc-on-touch: Pages stacked vertically, each one the same page but in a different currency of meaning. The tower never ends because the water keeps counting in new languages.

features.name: the-confluence-calculation
features.desc-on-touch: Where tributaries meet the main channel and their numbers merge, both values true and neither one standing. The sum is always what the water needs it to be.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the evening you learned to count like water
narr: She wades in at dusk, gesturing toward the ledger-pages.
Water carries numbers that belong to two places at once.
'Count it with me,' she says. You try. The sum shifts.
She laughs: 'Yes. The water knows. We'll never be right.'
You wade together into the current's mathematics of loss.

file.name: Estuary_Ledger_Current_Date_1993-2017.mp3
file.note: Sound recording of tidal flows, each frequency a different currency, blended until currency itself becomes meaningless. Final minute: pure water-sound, all counting dissolved.
